sources.title: RF-DETR: Neural Architecture Search for Real-Time Detection Transformers
sources.snippet: We visualize model predictions from RF-DETR (nano) and compare them with comparable detection and segmentation baselines in Figure 6. We find that RF-DETR (nano) predicts fewer false positives (e..g mistaking sign post for person).
